title: Bank of England MPC decision + Monetary Policy Report — the forecast round that must project the electricity-VAT base effect thirteen days before the print reveals it
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the page lists eight '2027 provisional dates' and reads 'Thursday 4 November', flagged as accompanied by a Monetary Policy Report. The Bank's own label is provisional, which is the honest reason for estimate on top of the standing taxonomy gap: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for a foreign central bank. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-11-17, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-11-17 LANE, 2026-09-09, and proposed for its GEOMETRY rather than for the rate decision. The full BoE 2027 provisional slate fetched today is 02-04 (MPR), 03-18, 04-29 (MPR), 06-17, 07-29 (MPR), 09-16, 11-04 (MPR), 12-16 — which puts this MPR THIRTEEN DAYS BEFORE the 2027-11-17 October CPI print, the identical spacing to the 2026-11-05 MPR and the 2026-11-18 print that the uk-cpi-2026-11-18 lane already documented. That matters because 2027-11-17 is the first print carrying the UPWARD electricity-VAT base effect created by SI 2026/987's zero-rate window (2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31): the committee must FORECAST a +5.0% year-on-year step on the CPI electricity index that it will not observe until after it has voted, and the December committee (2027-12-16) is the first to see it, with the November print landing 2027-12-15 the morning before that vote. THE ASYMMETRY THIS ENTRY EXISTS TO CARRY: the Bank's staff model VAT changes explicitly, so the base effect should already sit in the November projection; the tape, thirteen months past a cut that never showed up as a visible fall in the electricity index, will not have it in the narrative. A hot UK October 2027 print is therefore NOT a hawkish surprise to the committee that just published its forecast. Registered as FT-uk-cpi-2027-11-17-2 (prediction: the November 2027 MPR explicitly identifies the reversion / removal of the temporary zero rate in its near-term CPI profile), score by 2027-11-04; VOIDED if the zero rate is extended (FT-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01-1). Tiered LOW on this calendar's own terms: symbols: [], no gilt, sterling or UK-listed instrument tracked here — a foreign policy rate has no channel into an equity-and-earnings book. Estimate widens caution only.
